name: Zeil am Main (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically black and yellow, charged above the centre with the city arms of Zeil am Main (a black eagle and a red pennon on yellow and white).
history: Municipal flag of Zeil am Main; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Zeil am Main arms — eagle and pennon
